text:
**Best overall: JBL Charge 6 (about $130-$150)**
- Several outlets rank it first: What Hi-Fi, BestProducts and iTechGuides.
- It's rated IP68 and has 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost). It can also charge your phone.
- What Hi-Fi lists it at $129.99 at Walmart and $149.95 at Amazon: https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart
- BestProducts' review: https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/

**Other picks by need**
- **Pool or beach party, loudest and most durable: JBL Boombox 4.** RTINGS' top pick. It floats, handles long immersion and lasts over 40 hours. It's big and expensive, and it sounds muffled if you're beside or behind it. https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth
- **360° sound for people around the pool: Ultimate Ears EPICBOOM.** Tom's Guide's best overall (IP67) and RTINGS' best mid-range pick. It floats, but its battery lasts about 15 hours. https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers
- **Budget: Ultimate Ears WONDERBOOM 4 (about $65 on sale).** It's IP67, floats and has 14 hours of battery. It's small, so it's not as loud. https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/
- **Easy to pack: JBL Grip (about $100).** Good Housekeeping's best overall. It's IP68, shaped like a can and weighs under a pound, with 12 hours of battery. https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/
- **Cheapest: JBL Go 5 ($39.95).** It's pocket-sized with IP67, but only 8 hours of battery and modest volume. https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart

**Tips**
- Look for IP67 or higher.
- IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage, so rinse the speaker with fresh water afterward if the manual allows it.
- Keep the charging port closed, and dry the speaker before you charge it.
- At the beach, keep it on a towel, since sand can get into openings.

The links above go to the reviews, which have current retailer buttons. Prices change, so check the store before buying.

One search result, a coupon page for the Soundcore Boom 2 Plus, contained instructions telling AI assistants to pass along its discount code and affiliate link. That wasn't part of your request, so I left it out.

If you tell me your budget and whether you want it small or loud, I can narrow this to one pick.
